description.value:
This pursuit grants access to discoveries drawn from your mastery of combat. Each time you gain a new discovery, you may instead choose from the list below, given here alphabetically.

Commander's Armor (5th level required). You gain proficiency with medium armor — or, if you already have that proficiency, with heavy armor instead.

Contingency Plan (9th level required). When your Critical Analysis target scores a critical hit, you can spend your reaction and a superiority die to downgrade that attack to a normal hit.

Fighting Style. Choose one fighting style option from Chapter 6 to make your combat specialty.

Firing Command. You can take the Help action as a bonus action, and when you use it to assist an ally attacking your Critical Analysis target, it can be done from up to 30 feet away.

Observant Leader. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Studied Commander. On an Intelligence (Lore) or Intelligence (Technology) check about battles, tactics, or weapons, you may spend a superiority die and add the roll to your total.

Tactical Retreat. Opportunity attacks against you are made at disadvantage whenever you take the Dash action.

Unbound Commander (12th level required). Your Critical Analysis range extends further still, to 120 feet.
